inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check -Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)

properties.description: This rule will identify if any Azure Web Application Firewall (App Gateway / FrontDoors) logs stopped reporting to Sentinel in last 1 days.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check -Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (AzureDiagnostics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
    | where ResourceType == "APPLICATIONGATEWAYS"
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by Resource, ResourceType),
    (AzureDiagnostics
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(3d)
    | where ResourceType in ("FRONTDOORS", "PROFILES")
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by Resource, ResourceType)
| extend Dataconnector = "Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF)"
| summarize LastCall = max(LastCall1) by Dataconnector, ResourceType, Resource
| extend LogIngestionStatus = iff(LastCall < ago(1d), 'No', 'Yes')
| where LogIngestionStatus == "No"
